en.s: The siege of Adrianople took place in 378 following the Gothic victory at the Battle of Adrianople. Gothic forces were unable to breach the city walls and retreated. It was followed by an unsuccessful Gothic attempt to breach the walls of Constantinople.

zh.s: 阿德里安堡围城战发生于378年哥特人在阿德里安堡战役中获胜后。哥特军队未能攻破城墙，只得撤退。随后，他们又尝试攻破君士坦丁堡城墙，但同样未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of Lechfeld, also known as the Second Battle of Lechfeld, was a series of military engagements over the course of three days from 10 to 12 August 955 in which the Kingdom of Germany, led by King Otto I the Great, defeated the Hungarian army led by Harka Bulcsú and the chieftains Lél and Súr. With the German victory, further major invasions by the Magyars into Western Europe were ended.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱希菲尔德战役又称第二次莱希菲尔德战役，是一系列持续三天的军事交战，于955年8月10日至12日爆发。奥托一世大帝率领的德意志王国军队击败了由哈卡·布尔丘和两位部族首领莱尔、舒尔率领的匈牙利军队。德军获胜后，马扎尔人此后不再大规模入侵西欧。

en.s: The Battle of Azaz was an engagement fought in August 1030 near the Syrian town of Azaz between the Byzantine army, led by Emperor Romanos III Argyros (r. 1028–1034) in person, and the forces of the Mirdasid Emirate of Aleppo, likewise under the personal command of Emir Shibl al-Dawla Nasr (r. 1029–1038). The Mirdasids defeated the much larger Byzantine army and took great booty, even though they were eventually unable to capitalise on their victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿扎兹战役发生于1030年8月，地点在叙利亚阿扎兹附近。交战双方是亲自率军的拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯三世·阿尔吉罗斯（1028—1034年在位），以及同样亲自指挥军队的阿勒颇米尔达西埃米尔国埃米尔希卜勒·道莱·纳斯尔（1029—1038年在位）。米尔达西军队以较小兵力击败拜占庭大军，缴获大量战利品，但最终未能利用这场胜利取得更多成果。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

zh.s: 1109年8月10日，波兰王国军队与波美拉尼亚部族在纳克沃（Nakło nad Notecią）交战。

en.s: The Second Battle of Athenry took place at Athenry (Irish: Áth-na-Rí) in Ireland on 10 August 1316 during the Bruce campaign in Ireland.

zh.s: 第二次阿森里战役于1316年8月10日在爱尔兰阿森里（爱尔兰语：Áth-na-Rí）爆发，当时正值布鲁斯远征爱尔兰期间。

en.s: The Battle of Ardnocher or Ardnurcher (Irish: Áth an Urchair) was fought in modern County Westmeath, Ireland on 10 August 1329 between the Hiberno-Normans and the MacGeoghegans of Cenel Fiachaigh or Kenaleagh. The Normans were defeated. The Annales Hiberniae records that on 10 August 1329, Crown forces led by Thomas Butler attacked the fort of Ardnurcher (now the village of Horseleap) but were defeated by William Gallda MacGeoghegan.

zh.s: 阿德诺赫战役又称阿德努赫战役（爱尔兰语：Áth an Urchair），于1329年8月10日在今爱尔兰威斯米斯郡发生，交战双方是爱尔兰诺曼人和菲亚哈氏族的麦克乔格亨家族（又称肯纳利家族）。诺曼人战败。《爱尔兰编年史》记载，1329年8月10日，托马斯·巴特勒率领王室军队进攻阿德努赫堡（今霍斯利普村），但被威廉·加尔达·麦克乔格亨击败。

en.s: The Battle of Calliano was the decisive battle in the conflict between the Republic of Venice and Sigismund of Habsburg also known as the War of Rovereto. It was decisive to stop the Venetian advances into the Tyrol. The Venetian invasion force, led by Roberto Sanseverino d'Aragona, was camped near Pomarolo and Castel Nomi.

zh.s: 卡利亚诺战役是威尼斯共和国与哈布斯堡的西吉斯蒙德之间冲突中的决定性战役，这场冲突也称罗韦雷托战争。战役阻止了威尼斯向蒂罗尔推进。罗伯托·桑塞韦里诺·达拉戈纳率领的威尼斯入侵军驻扎在波马罗洛和卡斯特尔诺米附近。

en.s: The naval Battle of Saint-Mathieu took place on 10 August 1512 during the War of the League of Cambrai, near Brest, France, between an English fleet of 25 ships commanded by Sir Edward Howard and a Franco-Breton fleet of 22 ships commanded by René de Clermont. It is possibly the first battle between ships using cannon through ports, although this played a minor role in the fighting. This was one of only two full-fledged naval battles fought by King Henry VIII's Navy Royal. During the battle, each navy's largest and most powerful ship—Regent and Marie-la-Cordelière (or simply Cordelière)—was destroyed by a large explosion aboard the latter.

zh.s: 圣马蒂厄海战于1512年8月10日在法国布雷斯特附近爆发，是康布雷同盟战争的一部分。爱德华·霍华德爵士率领的25艘英国舰船与勒内·德·克莱蒙率领的22艘法兰西—布列塔尼舰船交战。这场战斗可能是舰船首次通过炮门发射火炮交战，但这对战斗过程影响不大。这是亨利八世的英国皇家海军仅有的两场全面海战之一。战斗中，两支舰队最大、火力最强的舰船——“摄政号”和“玛丽·拉·科德利埃号”（又称“科德利埃号”）均被炸毁；后者舰上发生了剧烈爆炸。

en.s: The battle of Palást was a military engagement between the Ottomans and the Habsburg army in Plášťovce. The Habsburg army attempted to stop the Ottoman advance but was defeated by the Pasha of Buda.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕拉什特战役是奥斯曼帝国与哈布斯堡军队在普拉什乔夫采发生的一场军事冲突。哈布斯堡军队试图阻止奥斯曼军队推进，但被布达帕夏击败。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Quentin of 1557 was a decisive engagement of the Italian War of 1551–1559 between the Kingdom of France and the Spanish Empire, at Saint-Quentin in Picardy. A Habsburg Spanish force under Duke Emmanuel Philibert of Savoy defeated a French army under the command of Louis de Gonzague, and Anne de Montmorency, Duke of Montmorency.

zh.s: 1557年圣康坦战役是1551年至1559年意大利战争期间的一场决定性战斗，交战双方是法国王国和西班牙帝国，战场位于皮卡第的圣康坦。萨伏依公爵埃马纽埃尔·菲利贝尔率领哈布斯堡西班牙军队，击败了由路易·德·贡扎格和蒙莫朗西公爵安娜·德·蒙莫朗西指挥的法军。

en.s: The Treaty of Nonsuch was signed on 10 August 1585 by Elizabeth I of England and the Dutch rebels fighting against Spanish rule. It was the first international treaty signed by what would become the Dutch Republic. It was signed at Nonsuch Palace, England.

zh.s: 诺恩苏奇条约于1585年8月10日由英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世与反抗西班牙统治的荷兰起义军签署。这是后来成立的荷兰共和国签署的第一份国际条约。条约在英格兰的诺恩苏奇宫签订。

en.t: The Swedish warship Vasa sinks on her maiden voyage off Stockholm
en.s: Vasa (previously Wasa) (Swedish pronunciation: [²vɑːsa] ) is a Swedish warship built between 1626 and 1628. The ship sank after sailing roughly 1,300 m (1,400 yd) into her maiden voyage on 10 August 1628. She fell into obscurity after most of her valuable bronze cannons were salvaged in the 17th century, until she was located again in the late 1950s in a busy shipping area in Stockholm harbor.

zh.t: 瑞典战舰“瓦萨号”处女航时在斯德哥尔摩外海沉没
zh.s: “瓦萨号”（曾拼作Wasa；瑞典语发音：[²vɑːsa]）是一艘瑞典战舰，建于1626年至1628年。1628年8月10日，首次航行约1300米（1400码）后，战舰沉没。17世纪打捞出大部分珍贵青铜炮后，“瓦萨号”逐渐被人遗忘；直到20世纪50年代末，人们才在斯德哥尔摩港繁忙的航道附近重新发现它。

en.s: The Treaty of London was an agreement signed between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland in 1641 which formally brought an end to the 1639 to 1640 Bishops' Wars. Charles I was king of both countries but, since 1639, Scotland had been under the control of a political faction who opposed the king and were known as the Covenanters. In August 1640, a Covenanter army invaded and occupied parts of northern England. The Covenanters and Charles reached an interim truce in October in the Treaty of Ripon. This mandated that the English government pay for the ongoing Covenanter occupation pending further negotiations over a final settlement. Furthermore, Charles was required to summon a new parliament of England which assembled in November 1640. After months of negotiations, on 10 August 1641 Charles signed a long-term peace treaty.

zh.s: 1641年，英格兰王国和苏格兰王国签署《伦敦条约》，正式结束1639年至1640年的主教战争。查理一世同时是两国国王，但自1639年以来，苏格兰一直由反对国王的政治派别圣约派控制。1640年8月，圣约派军队入侵并占领英格兰北部部分地区。同年10月，圣约派与查理一世在《里彭条约》中达成临时停战协议；该协议要求英格兰政府为圣约派持续占领当地支付费用，并继续谈判最终和约。此外，查理一世还必须召集新的英格兰议会，该议会于1640年11月召开。经过数月谈判，查理一世于1641年8月10日签署了长期和平条约。

en.s: The Pueblo Revolt of 1680, also known as Popé's Rebellion or Po'pay's Rebellion, was an uprising of most of the Indigenous Pueblo people against the Spanish colonists in the province of Santa Fe de Nuevo México, larger than present-day New Mexico. Persistent Spanish policies, coupled with incidents of brutality and cruelty such as those that occurred in 1599 and resulted in the Ácoma Massacre, stoked animosity and gave rise to the eventual Revolt of 1680.
en.n: The Pueblo Revolt begins in New Mexico.

zh.s: 1680年普韦布洛起义又称波佩起义或波派起义，是大多数原住民普韦布洛人反抗西班牙殖民者的起义，发生在新墨西哥省圣菲·德·新墨西哥地区，其范围比今天的新墨西哥州更大。西班牙持续推行的政策，以及1599年阿科马大屠杀等暴行和残酷行径，激起了当地人的不满，最终引发1680年起义。
zh.n: 普韦布洛起义在新墨西哥爆发。

en.s: The action of 10 August 1695 was a naval skirmish between the Swedish Navy warship Wachtmeister and a four-ship squadron of the English Royal Navy during the Nine Years' War. It ended with the English capturing Wachtmeister.

zh.s: 1695年8月10日海战是九年战争期间的一场海上小规模交战，交战双方是瑞典海军战舰“瓦赫特迈斯特号”和英国皇家海军一支由四艘舰船组成的分队。最终英国人俘获了“瓦赫特迈斯特号”。

en.s: The siege of Barcelona of 1697 was successfully conducted during the Nine Years' War by France. Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme, commanding some 32,000 troops (reinforced with troops from the ended Italian front of the war), forced the garrison, under Prince George of Hesse-Darmstadt, to capitulate on 10 August.

zh.s: 1697年巴塞罗那围城战是九年战争期间法军成功发动的一场围城战。路易·约瑟夫·德·旺多姆公爵率领约3.2万名士兵，其中包括从已经结束的意大利战线调来的增援部队，迫使由黑森-达姆施塔特的乔治亲王率领的守军于8月10日投降。

en.s: After the conclusion of the 1698 English general election the government led by the Whig Junto believed it had held its ground against the opposition. Over the previous few years, divisions had emerged within the Whig party between the 'court' supporters of the junto and the 'country' faction, who disliked the royal prerogative, were concerned about governmental corruption, and opposed a standing army.

zh.s: 1698年英格兰大选结束后，辉格党核心内阁领导的政府认为自己顶住了反对派的攻势。此前几年，辉格党内部已出现分歧：一派是支持核心内阁的“宫廷派”，另一派是反对王权特权、担忧政府腐败并反对设立常备军的“乡村派”。

en.s: The Battle of Colachel (or The Battle of Kolachel) was fought on 10 August 1741 [O.S. 31 July 1741] between the Indian kingdom of Travancore and the Dutch East India Company. During the Travancore-Dutch War, King Marthanda Varma's (1729–1758) forces defeated the Dutch East India Company's forces led by Admiral Eustachius De Lannoy on 10 August 1741. Travancore triumphed in the war with the military efforts of the Travancore army at land and fishermen community at sea. The war marked the beginning of the long-standing conflicts and negotiations that later became known as the Travancore–Dutch War.

zh.s: 科拉切尔战役又称科拉切尔之战，于1741年8月10日（儒略历1741年7月31日）在印度特拉凡哥尔王国与荷兰东印度公司之间爆发。特拉凡哥尔—荷兰战争期间，马尔坦达·瓦尔马国王（1729—1758年在位）率军于1741年8月10日击败由海军上将尤斯塔修斯·德·拉诺伊率领的荷兰东印度公司军队。特拉凡哥尔凭借陆上的军队和海上的渔民力量赢得战争。这场战争也开启了长期的冲突与谈判，后来这些冲突和谈判被称为特拉凡哥尔—荷兰战争。

en.s: The Battle of Rottofreddo or Rottofreno (10 August 1746) was fought during the War of Austrian Succession between a Habsburg Austrian army and a Bourbon army consisting of Spanish and French forces. The Spanish were led by Jean Thierry du Mont, comte de Gages and the French by Jean-Baptiste Francois des Marets, marquis de Maillebois.

zh.s: 罗托弗雷多战役又称罗托弗雷诺战役（1746年8月10日），发生于奥地利王位继承战争期间。交战双方是哈布斯堡奥地利军队与波旁王朝军队，后者由西班牙和法国部队组成。西班牙军由加热斯伯爵让·蒂埃里·迪·蒙指挥，法国军由马耶博侯爵让-巴蒂斯特·弗朗索瓦·德·马雷指挥。

en.s: The Expulsion of the Acadians was the forced removal of the French colonists of the North American region historically known as Acadia between 1755 and 1764 by Great Britain. It included the modern Canadian Maritime provinces of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, and Prince Edward Island, along with part of the US state of Maine. The Expulsion occurred during the French and Indian War, the North American theatre of the Seven Years' War.

zh.s: 1755年至1764年，英国强行驱逐了历史上称为阿卡迪亚的北美地区的法国殖民者。驱逐范围包括今加拿大海洋省份新斯科舍、新不伦瑞克和爱德华王子岛，以及美国缅因州的部分地区。事件发生在法国与印第安人战争期间，该战争是七年战争在北美的战场。

en.s: The siege of Fort Pitt took place during June and July 1763 in what is now the city of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. The siege was a part of Pontiac's War, an effort by Native Americans to remove the Anglo-Americans from the Ohio Country and Allegheny Plateau after they refused to honor their promises and treaties to leave voluntarily after the defeat of the French.

zh.s: 皮特堡围城战于1763年6月至7月发生在今美国宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市境内，是庞蒂亚克战争的一部分。美国原住民试图将英裔美国人赶出俄亥俄地区和阿勒格尼高原；此前他们拒绝履行承诺与条约，不愿在法国战败后自愿离开。

en.s: The action of 10 August 1780 was a minor naval engagement that took place off Brest during the American Revolutionary War between a Royal Navy frigate and a French Navy frigate. This was the first engagement thought to involve the use of the carronade.

zh.s: 1780年8月10日海战是美国独立战争期间在布雷斯特附近发生的一场小规模海战，交战双方是一艘英国皇家海军护卫舰和一艘法国海军护卫舰。这被认为是首次使用卡隆炮的交战。

en.s: The Insurrection of 10 August 1792 was one of the defining events in the history of the French Revolution. The storming of the Tuileries Palace by the National Guard of the insurrectional Paris Commune and revolutionary fédérés from Marseilles and Brittany resulted in the fall of the French monarchy. King Louis XVI and the royal family took shelter with the Legislative Assembly, which was suspended.

zh.t: 法国大革命中的1792年8月10日起义
zh.s: 1792年8月10日起义是法国大革命史上的标志性事件之一。起义巴黎公社的国民卫队与来自马赛和布列塔尼的革命联邦军攻入杜伊勒里宫，法国君主制由此覆灭。路易十六国王和王室成员到立法议会避难，议会随后被暂停运作。

en.s: The invasion of Corsica was a campaign fought in the spring and summer of 1794 by combined British military and Corsican irregular forces against a French garrison, early in the French Revolutionary Wars. The campaign centred on sieges of three principal towns in Northern Corsica; San Fiorenzo, Bastia and Calvi, which were in turn surrounded, besieged and bombarded until by August 1794 French forces had been driven from the island entirely.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科西嘉岛入侵是1794年春夏期间的一场军事行动，由英国军队和科西嘉非正规武装联合对抗法国驻军，发生于法国大革命战争初期。行动围绕科西嘉岛北部三座主要城镇展开：圣菲奥伦佐、巴斯蒂亚和卡尔维。英军与科西嘉武装先后包围、围攻并炮击这些城镇，至1794年8月，法军已被彻底赶出该岛。

en.s: The action of 10 August 1805 was a minor naval engagement between two frigates of the British Royal Navy, HMS Phoenix and the French Navy Didon as part of the Napoleonic Wars. After an hour of action Didon surrendered to Phoenix.

zh.s: 1805年8月10日海战是拿破仑战争期间的一场小规模海战，交战双方是英国皇家海军的“凤凰号”护卫舰和法国海军的“迪东号”护卫舰。交战一小时后，“迪东号”向“凤凰号”投降。

en.s: The Battle of Kauhajoki was fought between Swedish and Russian troops on August 10, 1808. After the important Swedish victory at the Battle of Lapua the force under the command of Georg Carl von Döbeln defeated a Russian force near Kauhajoki, Southern Ostrobothnia, Finland.

en.s: Ecuador, officially the Republic of Ecuador, is a country in northwestern South America, bordered by Colombia on the north, Peru on the east and south, and the Pacific Ocean on the west. en.s: The invasion of Guadeloupe occurred between 8 and 10 August 1815 during the Hundred Days. Following Napoleon's return to power, a conflict began in the French West Indian colony of Guadeloupe over whether or not to support him, which ended on 19 June when Governor Charles-Alexandre Linois declared his support for Napoleon. A British expeditionary force under Lieutenant-general Sir James Leith, augmented by French forces from Martinique, proceeded to set sail for Guadeloupe.

en.s: Bolívar's campaign to liberate New Granada, also known as the Liberation Campaign of 1819, was part of the Colombian and Venezuelan wars of independence and was one of the many military campaigns fought by Simón Bolívar. en.s: The Battle of Silao took place on August 10, 1860 in the vicinity of Silao in Guanajuato state, Mexico, between elements of the liberal army, under the command of General Jesus Gonzalez Ortega and Ignacio Zaragoza with a force of 8,000 men and elements of the conservative army commanded General Miguel Miramon by commanding an army of 3,282 during the War of Reform. The battle ended as liberal victory, even almost captures the General Miguel Miramon who escaped in the disorder that generated them Republican artillery, leaving artillery, ammunition and implements of war.

zh.s: 锡劳战役于1860年8月10日在墨西哥瓜纳华托州锡劳附近爆发。改革战争期间，耶稣·冈萨雷斯·奥尔特加将军和伊格纳西奥·萨拉戈萨率领的自由派军队共8000人，与米格尔·米拉蒙将军指挥的保守派军队（3282人）交战。自由派获胜，米拉蒙也险些被俘；共和军炮火造成混乱，他趁乱逃脱。保守派留下了火炮、弹药和作战装备。

en.s: The Battle of Wilson's Creek, also known as the Battle of Oak Hills, was the first major battle of the Trans-Mississippi Theater of the American Civil War. It was fought on August 10, 1861, near Springfield, Missouri. In August, Confederates under Brigadier General Benjamin McCulloch and Missouri State Guard troops under Maj. Gen. Sterling Price approached Brig. Gen. Nathaniel Lyon's Army of the West, camped at Springfield.

zh.s: 威尔逊溪战役又称橡树山战役，是美国内战密西西比河以西战区的第一场大型战役，于1861年8月10日在密苏里州斯普林菲尔德附近爆发。8月，班杰明·麦卡洛克准将率领的邦联军，以及斯特林·普赖斯少将率领的密苏里州卫队，向驻扎在斯普林菲尔德的内森尼尔·莱昂准将西部军团逼近。

en.s: The Nueces Massacre, also known as the Massacre on the Nueces, was a violent confrontation between Confederate soldiers and German Texans on August 10, 1862, in Kinney County, Texas. Many first-generation immigrants from Germany settled in Central Texas in a region known as the Hill Country. They tended to support the Union and were opposed to the institution of slavery. Because of these sentiments, the Confederate States of America imposed martial law on Central Texas. A group of Germans, fleeing from the Hill Country to Mexico and onward after that to Union-controlled New Orleans, was confronted by a company of Confederate soldiers on the banks of the Nueces River.

zh.s: 纽埃塞斯河大屠杀又称纽埃塞斯河畔大屠杀，是南方邦联士兵与德裔得克萨斯人之间的一场暴力冲突，于1862年8月10日在得克萨斯州金尼县发生。许多第一代德国移民定居在得克萨斯州中部一个被称为丘陵地带的地区。他们倾向于支持联邦，并反对奴隶制。由于这些立场，美利坚联盟国在得克萨斯州中部实施戒严。一群德国人从丘陵地带逃往墨西哥，随后打算前往联邦控制的新奥尔良，途中在纽埃塞斯河岸遭到一队南方邦联士兵拦截。

en.s: The Uruguayan War (10 August 1864 – 20 February 1865) was fought between Uruguay's governing Blanco Party and an alliance consisting of the Empire of Brazil and the Uruguayan Colorado Party, covertly supported by Argentina. Since its independence, Uruguay had been ravaged by intermittent struggles between the Colorado and Blanco factions, each attempting to seize and maintain power in turn. The Colorado leader Venancio Flores launched the Liberating Crusade in 1863, an insurrection aimed at toppling Bernardo Berro, who presided over a Colorado–Blanco coalition (Fusionist) government. Flores was aided by Argentina, whose president Bartolomé Mitre provided him with supplies, Argentine volunteers and river transport for troops.

zh.s: 乌拉圭战争于1864年8月10日至1865年2月20日进行，交战双方是执政的白党，以及巴西帝国和乌拉圭红党组成、并得到阿根廷秘密支持的联盟。乌拉圭独立后，红党和白党派系间断爆发冲突，双方轮流争夺并巩固权力。1863年，红党领导人维南西奥·弗洛雷斯发动“解放十字军”起义，意图推翻主持红白联合（融合派）政府的贝尔纳多·贝罗。阿根廷总统巴托洛梅·米特雷向弗洛雷斯提供物资、阿根廷志愿兵和运送部队的河运船只。

en.s: The Battle of the Yellow Sea (Japanese: 黄海海戦 Kōkai kaisen; Russian: Бой в Жёлтом море) was a major naval engagement of the Russo-Japanese War, fought on 10 August 1904. In the Russian Navy, it was referred to as the Battle of 10 August. The battle foiled an attempt by the Russian fleet at Port Arthur to break out and form up with counterparts from Vladivostok, forcing them to return to port. Four days later, the Battle off Ulsan similarly ended the Vladivostok group's sortie, forcing both fleets to remain at anchor.

zh.s: 黄海海战（日语：黄海海戦，Kōkai kaisen；俄语：Бой в Жёлтом море）是日俄战争期间的一场重要海战，于1904年8月10日爆发。俄罗斯海军称之为“8月10日海战”。这场战斗挫败了旅顺港俄国舰队突围并与海参崴舰队会合的企图，迫使该舰队返回港口。四天后，蔚山外海海战也使海参崴舰队的出击受挫，迫使两支舰队都留在锚地。

en.s: The Treaty of Sèvres (French: Traité de Sèvres) was a 1920 treaty signed between some of the Allies of World War I and the Ottoman Empire, but not ratified. The treaty would have required the cession of large parts of Ottoman territory to France, the United Kingdom, Greece, and Italy, as well as creating large occupation zones within the Ottoman Empire. It was one of a series of treaties that the Central Powers signed with the Allied Powers after their defeat in World War I. Hostilities had already ended with the Armistice of Mudros. The treaty was signed on 10 August 1920 in an exhibition room at the Manufacture nationale de Sèvres porcelain factory in Sèvres, France.

zh.s: 《塞夫尔条约》（法语：Traité de Sèvres）是第一次世界大战后协约国部分成员与奥斯曼帝国于1920年签署的一项条约，但未获批准。条约原本要求奥斯曼帝国将大片领土割让给法国、英国、希腊和意大利，并在奥斯曼帝国内设立大片占领区。这是中央同盟国战败后与协约国签署的一系列条约之一。敌对行动早在《穆德洛斯停战协定》签署时就已结束。1920年8月10日，条约在法国塞夫尔的塞夫尔国家瓷器制造厂展厅签署。

The two and a half month battle resulted in heavy losses of the Japanese 101st and 106th Divisions.

en.s: HG 70 was an Allied convoy of the HG (Homeward from Gibraltar) series during World War II. It was attacked by a pack of ten U-boats, without success. All U-boats were beaten off, and they sank no ships of the convoy. Two ships were lost to aircraft; 23 ships arrived safely.

en.s: The Aćimović Offensive, also known as the Aćimović Pursuit, was a military operation of the Serbian State Guard and Chetniks of Kosta Pećanac against partisan detachments in Southeastern Serbia. It was named after Milan Aćimović, the Minister of Internal Affairs in the collaborationist government of Milan Nedić, who was entrusted with preparing the offensive. Occupation troops (German and Bulgarian) did not directly participate in the operation; it was entirely entrusted to collaborationist units. This was one of the most organized and largest offensives against partisan forces in Šumadija, Eastern and Southern Serbia, involving about 10,000 collaborationist troops (Pećanac's Chetniks, the Serbian State Guard, and the Serbian Volunteer Corps). In the third stage of the offensive, which began on 10 August 1942, the Rasina, Toplica and Jablanica detachments were targeted, followed by the Leskovac and Babič detachments.

zh.s: 阿奇莫维奇攻势又称阿奇莫维奇追击，是塞尔维亚国家卫队和科斯塔·佩恰纳茨的切特尼克部队在塞尔维亚东南部针对游击队分遣队开展的一次军事行动。行动以米兰·阿奇莫维奇命名；他是与占领者合作的米兰·内迪奇政府的内政部长，负责筹备这次攻势。德国和保加利亚占领军没有直接参战，行动完全交由当地合作政权部队执行。这是舒马迪亚、塞尔维亚东部和南部地区针对游击队规模最大、组织最严密的攻势之一，约有1万名合作政权部队人员参加，包括佩恰纳茨的切特尼克部队、塞尔维亚国家卫队和塞尔维亚志愿军团。攻势第三阶段于1942年8月10日开始，目标是拉西纳、托普利察和亚布拉尼察分遣队，随后又针对莱斯科瓦茨和巴比奇分遣队。

en.s: The Battle of Kokoda consisted of two engagements fought in late July – early August 1942. Forming part of the Kokoda Track campaign of the Second World War, the battle involved military forces from Australia, supported by the United States, fighting against Japanese troops from Major General Tomitaro Horii's South Seas Detachment who had landed around Buna and Gona in Papua mid-July 1942, with the intent of capturing Port Moresby to the south via the overland route.

en.s: Convoy SC 94 was the 94th of the numbered series of World War II slow convoys of merchant ships from Sydney, Cape Breton Island, Nova Scotia, to Liverpool. The ships departed Sydney on 31 July 1942 and were met by Mid-Ocean Escort Force Group C-1.

en.s: The Battle of Narva was a World War II military campaign, lasting from 2 February to 10 August 1944, in which the German Army Detachment "Narwa" and the Soviet Leningrad Front fought for possession of the strategically important Narva Isthmus. The battle took place in the northern section of the Eastern Front and consisted of two major phases: the Battle for Narva Bridgehead (February to July 1944), and the Battle of Tannenberg Line (July–August 1944).

zh.s: 纳尔瓦战役是第二次世界大战期间的一场军事行动，持续于1944年2月2日至8月10日。德国“纳尔瓦”军团和苏联列宁格勒方面军争夺具有重要战略意义的纳尔瓦地峡。战斗发生在东线北段，分为两个主要阶段：争夺纳尔瓦桥头堡的战斗（1944年2月至7月）以及坦能堡防线战役（1944年7月至8月）。

en.s: The Battle of Tannenberg Line (German: Die Schlacht um die Tannenbergstellung; Russian: Битва за линию «Танненберг») or the Battle of the Blue Hills (Estonian: Sinimägede lahing) was a military engagement between the German Army Detachment Narwa and the Soviet Leningrad Front. They fought for the strategically important Narva Isthmus from 25 July–10 August 1944. The battle was fought on the Eastern Front during World War II.

zh.s: 坦能堡防线战役又称蓝丘战役（德语：Die Schlacht um die Tannenbergstellung；俄语：Битва за линию «Танненберг»；爱沙尼亚语：Sinimägede lahing），是德国“纳尔瓦”军团与苏联列宁格勒方面军之间的一场军事交战。双方于1944年7月25日至8月10日在具有重要战略意义的纳尔瓦地峡交战。这场战斗发生在第二次世界大战东线战场。

en.s: Operation Totalize (also spelled Operation Totalise in recent British sources) was an offensive launched by Allied troops in the First Canadian Army during the later stages of Operation Overlord, from 8 to 10 August 1944. The intention was to break through the German defences south of Caen on the eastern flank of the Allied positions in Normandy and exploit success by driving south, to capture the high ground north of the city of Falaise.

The battle was a critical component of Operation Forager.

en.s: The Potsdam Declaration, or the Proclamation Defining Terms for Japanese Surrender, was a statement that called for the surrender of all Japanese armed forces during World War II. On July 26, 1945, United States president Harry S. Truman, United Kingdom prime minister Winston Churchill, and President of China Chiang Kai-shek issued the document, which outlined the terms of surrender for the Empire of Japan, as agreed upon at the Potsdam Conference.
en.n: The Japanese government announced that a message had been sent to the Allies accepting the terms of the Potsdam Declaration provided that it "does not comprise any demand that prejudices the prerogatives of the Emperor as sovereign ruler."

zh.s: 《波茨坦公告》又称《规定日本投降条件的公告》，要求第二次世界大战期间所有日本武装部队投降。1945年7月26日，美国总统哈里·S·杜鲁门、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和中国总统蒋介石发布了这份文件，其中列明的日本投降条件是在波茨坦会议上商定的。
zh.n: 日本政府宣布已向盟军发出消息，同意接受《波茨坦公告》的条款，但前提是条款“不得包含任何损害天皇作为主权统治者特权的要求”。

en.s: Operation Beleaguer was the codename for the United States Marine Corps' occupation of northeastern China's Hebei and Shandong provinces from 1945 until 1949. The Marines were tasked with overseeing the repatriation of more than 600,000 Japanese and Koreans who remained in China at the end of World War II. During the four-year occupation, American forces engaged in several skirmishes with the People's Liberation Army, while successfully evacuating thousands of foreign nationals.

en.s: Longhai Campaign (陇海战役), also known as the Campaign along the Longhai (Lanzhou – Lianyungang) Railway (陇海路战役), was a campaign launched against the nationalists by the communists during Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era. en.s: The siege of Surakarta was a military campaign during the Indonesian National Revolution. The Indonesian Republican forces (TNI) briefly infiltrated the city of Surakarta (also known as Solo) before being repulsed by Dutch special forces (RST). Despite the defeat, the battle, together with an earlier attack on Yogyakarta, provided a morale boost for the Indonesians.

en.s: Operation Camargue was one of the largest operations by the French Far East Expeditionary Corps and Vietnamese National Army in the First Indochina War. It took place from 28 July until 10 August 1953. French armored platoons, airborne units and troops delivered by landing craft to the coast of central Annam, modern-day Vietnam, attempted to sweep forces of the communist Viet Minh from the critical Route 1.

zh.s: 卡马尔格行动是第一次印度支那战争期间，法国远东远征军和越南国军开展的规模最大行动之一。行动于1953年7月28日至8月10日进行。法军派出装甲排、空降部队以及由登陆艇运抵安南中部海岸的部队，试图沿重要的1号公路清剿越盟部队。

en.s: The Society for American Baseball Research (SABR) is a membership organization dedicated to fostering the research and dissemination of the history and statistical record of baseball. The organization was founded in Cooperstown, New York, on August 10, 1971, at a meeting of 16 "statistorians" coordinated by sportswriter Bob Davids. The organization now reports a membership of over 7,500 and is based in Phoenix, Arizona.

en.s: The 1979 Norfolk Island legislative election was held on 10 August 1979 to elect the 1st Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly, the prime legislative body of Norfolk Island. This was the first election for the Assembly − which replaced the Norfolk Island Council − after Norfolk Island returned to self-governance. Voters were asked in a referendum prior to the election whether to introduce the proportional representation electoral system, with the proposal unsuccessful.

en.s: The 34th Locarno Film Festival was held from 31 July to 10 August 1981 in Locarno, Switzerland. This was Jean-Pierre Brossard's last year as festival director. It included a popular retrospective of 1950s U.S. films and midnight showings of films such as Polyester directed by John Waters. The screening of Pier Palo Pasolini's Salo was so crowded that it was screened twice due to audience demand.

en.s: The 37th Locarno Film Festival was held from 10 to 19 August 1984 in Locarno, Switzerland. For the first time in the history of the festival, the President of the Swiss Confederation, leader of Switzerland, attended the festival. Other notable attendees included writer Patricia Highsmith, actor John Hurt and ambassadors from Italy and India. This was considered the highest attended Locarno festival to date, with an unofficial estimate of 50,000 attendees.

en.s: Al-Muhtadee Billah ibni Hassanal Bolkiah (Jawi: المهتدي بالله ابن حسن البلقية; born 17 February 1974) is the eldest son of Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah and his wife Queen Saleha. en.s: On August 10, 1999, at around 10:50 a.m. PT, American white supremacist Buford O. en.s: STS-105 was the 30th mission of Space Shuttle Discovery, in which Discovery went to the International Space Station. It launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on 10 August 2001. This mission was Discovery's final mission until STS-114, because Discovery was grounded for a refit, and then all Shuttles were grounded in the wake of the Columbia disaster.

en.s: Sepahan Airlines Flight 5915 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Iranian capital Tehran Mehrabad International Airport to Tabas, South Khorasan province, Iran. On 10 August 2014, the HESA IrAn-140 twin turboprop serving the flight crashed shortly after takeoff from Mehrabad International Airport, falling into a boulevard near the Azadi Stadium. Of the 42 passengers and six crew on board, 40 people died.

zh.t: 塞帕汉航空5915号班机空难
zh.s: 塞帕汉航空5915号班机是一趟定期国内客运航班，从伊朗首都德黑兰的梅赫拉巴德国际机场飞往南呼罗珊省塔巴斯。2014年8月10日，执飞该航班的HESA IrAn-140双涡轮螺旋桨飞机从梅赫拉巴德机场起飞后不久坠毁，落在阿扎迪体育场附近的一条林荫大道上。机上有42名乘客和6名机组人员，其中40人遇难。

en.s: The 2014 Nagano gubernatorial election was held on 10 August 2014 to elect the next governor of Nagano (長野県, Nagano-ken), a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu island. Incumbent Governor Shuichi Abe was re-elected for a second term, defeating Shumpo Noguchi with 84.22% of the vote.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Turkey on 10 August 2014 in order to elect the 12th President. Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan was elected outright with an absolute majority of the vote in the first round, making a scheduled run-off for 24 August unnecessary. The election took place under reforms resulting from the 2007 constitutional referendum, which introduced a direct national vote, rather than election by members of the parliament.

zh.s: 土耳其于2014年8月10日举行总统选举，选出第12任总统。总理雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安在首轮投票中以绝对多数当选，因此原定于8月24日举行的第二轮投票取消。此次选举依据2007年宪法公投后的改革举行，由全民直接投票选出总统，而非由议员选举。

en.s: The 2014 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield supported by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 92nd FA Community Shield, an annual English football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup. en.s: The 2016 Moldovan Super Cup was the 10th Moldovan Super Cup (Romanian: Supercupa Moldovei), an annual Moldovan football match played by the winner of the national football league (the National Division) and the winner of the national Cup. The match was played between Sheriff Tiraspol, champions of the 2015–16 National Division, and Zaria Bălți, winners of the 2015–16 Moldovan Cup. It was held at the Sheriff Small Arena on 10 August 2016.

en.s: The 2016 Suruga Bank Championship (Japanese: スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2016; Spanish: Copa Suruga Bank 2016) was the ninth edition of the Suruga Bank Championship, the club football match co-organized by the Japan Football Association, the football governing body of Japan, CONMEBOL, the football governing body of South America, and J.League, the professional football league of Japan, between the winners of the previous season's J.League Cup and Copa Sudamericana. The match was contested between Japanese team Kashima Antlers, the 2015 J.League Cup winners, and Colombian team Santa Fe, the 2015 Copa Sudamericana winners. It was hosted by Kashima Antlers at the Kashima Soccer Stadium in Kashima on 10 August 2016.

zh.s: 2016年骏河银行锦标赛（日语：スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2016；西班牙语：Copa Suruga Bank 2016）是第九届骏河银行锦标赛。这项俱乐部足球赛由日本足球协会、南美洲足球联合会（CONMEBOL）和日本职业足球联赛（J联赛）共同举办，参赛双方为上赛季日本联赛杯和南美解放者杯的冠军。本届对阵双方是2015年日本联赛杯冠军鹿岛鹿角队和2015年南美杯冠军哥伦比亚圣菲独立队。比赛由鹿岛鹿角队承办，于2016年8月10日在鹿岛足球场举行。

en.s: The 2017 Israel Super Cup is the 22nd Israel Super Cup (27th, including unofficial matches, as the competition wasn't played within the Israel Football Association in its first 5 editions, until 1969), an annual Israel football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup. This is the second time since 1990 that the match was staged, after a planned resumption of the cup was cancelled in 2014.

zh.s: 2017年以色列超级杯是第22届赛事；若将该项赛事未纳入以色列足球协会体系的前五届非正式比赛也计算在内，则是第27届。这项年度足球赛由上赛季以色列顶级联赛冠军对阵以色列国家杯冠军。这是自1990年以来该赛事第二次举行；原定于2014年恢复举办，但计划后来取消。

en.s: The Ghazni offensive began on 10 August 2018, when Taliban fighters launched an assault on the city of Ghazni, Afghanistan's sixth largest city and one which has been culturally and strategically important for much of the country's history. The attack resulted in the deaths of hundreds of insurgents, soldiers, police, and civilians. The city also sustained large-scale property damage.

zh.s: 加兹尼攻势于2018年8月10日开始，当天塔利班武装人员袭击阿富汗第六大城市加兹尼。加兹尼在阿富汗历史上长期具有文化和战略重要性。袭击造成数百名叛乱分子、士兵、警察和平民死亡，城市也遭到大规模财产破坏。

en.s: Horizon Air is an American regional airline headquartered in SeaTac, Washington, United States, within the Seattle metropolitan area. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Alaska Air Group, and it is paid by fellow group member Alaska Airlines to staff, operate, and maintain aircraft used on flights that are scheduled, marketed, and sold by Alaska Airlines.

zh.s: 地平线航空是一家美国区域航空公司，总部位于华盛顿州西塔科，地处西雅图都会区内。该公司是阿拉斯加航空集团的全资子公司；集团旗下的阿拉斯加航空向其支付费用，由地平线航空为阿拉斯加航空安排、销售和执飞的航班配备人员，并负责飞机运营和维护。

en.s: The 2019 Bærum murder and mosque attack occurred on 10 August 2019 at the Al-Noor Islamic Centre in Bærum, Norway, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) west of the capital city Oslo. Philip Manshaus, a 21-year-old Norwegian man, murdered his 17-year-old adopted sister Johanne Ihle-Hansen at their home. He then drove to the mosque and shot his way through the glass door before opening fire, hitting no one; the mosque was almost empty, as prayer had ended.

zh.t: 2019年贝鲁姆谋杀案与清真寺袭击
zh.s: 2019年贝鲁姆谋杀案与清真寺袭击于2019年8月10日发生在挪威贝鲁姆的阿尔努尔伊斯兰中心，距首都奥斯陆以西约20公里。21岁的挪威男子菲利普·曼斯豪斯在家中杀害了自己17岁的养妹约翰娜·伊勒-汉森。随后他开车前往清真寺，开枪打碎玻璃门后向内射击，但没有击中任何人；当时清真寺几乎空无一人，因为礼拜已经结束。

Braine resigned just two months later, triggering a sixth leadership election.

zh.s: 英国独立党党魁选举在杰拉德·巴顿于6月2日离职后举行。选举结果于2019年8月10日公布，理查德·布雷恩当选党魁。这是该党三年内举行的第五次党魁选举。两个月后，布雷恩辞职，触发第六次党魁选举。

en.t: Thirty-two are killed and one million are evacuated as Typhoon Lekima makes landfall in Zhejiang, China. Earlier it had caused flooding in the Philippines
en.s: Typhoon Lekima, known in the Philippines as Typhoon Hanna, was the fourth costliest typhoon in Chinese history. The ninth named storm of the 2019 Pacific typhoon season, Lekima originated from a tropical depression that formed east of the Philippines on 30 July. It gradually organized, became a tropical storm, and was named on 4 August. Lekima intensified under favorable environmental conditions and peaked as a Category 4–equivalent Super typhoon.

zh.t: 利奇马台风在中国浙江登陆，造成32人死亡、100万人撤离；此前台风已在菲律宾引发洪灾
zh.s: 利奇马台风在菲律宾称为汉娜台风，是中国历史上造成经济损失第四高的台风。它是2019年太平洋台风季第九个获得命名的风暴，7月30日在菲律宾以东形成热带低压，之后逐渐发展组织成热带风暴，并于8月4日获名。利奇马在有利的环境条件下增强，达到相当于四级飓风强度的超级台风峰值。

en.s: General elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 10 August 2020, to elect 41 members to the 12th Trinidad and Tobago Republican Parliament. It was the 14th election since gaining independence from the United Kingdom in 1962 and the 22nd national election in Trinidad and Tobago. The result was a victory for the incumbent People's National Movement, which received 49.05% of the vote and won 22 of the 41 seats in the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 特立尼达和多巴哥于2020年8月10日举行大选，选出第12届共和议会的41名议员。这是该国1962年脱离英国独立以来的第14次选举，也是其第22次全国选举。执政的人民民族运动获胜，得到49.05%的选票，并赢得众议院41席中的22席。

en.t: Derecho in Iowa becomes the most costly thunderstorm disaster in U.S. history
en.s: The 2020 Midwest derecho was an unusually destructive and extremely powerful progressive derecho that devastated much of the Midwestern United States, primarily eastern Nebraska, Iowa, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana. It caused high winds and spawned an outbreak of weak tornadoes. Some areas reported torrential rain and large hail. The event came with no prior warning as weather forecast did not show the possibility of a derecho occurring until it was already in progress.

zh.t: 爱荷华州德雷乔风暴成为美国史上损失最严重的雷暴灾害
zh.s: 2020年中西部德雷乔风暴是一场极具破坏力、威力异常强大的直线型风暴，重创美国中西部大部分地区，主要包括内布拉斯加州东部、爱荷华州、伊利诺伊州、威斯康星州和印第安纳州。风暴带来强风，并引发一系列弱龙卷风。部分地区出现暴雨和大冰雹。事前没有预警，因为天气预报直到风暴已经开始后才显示可能发生德雷乔风暴。

en.s: On August 10, 2021, a patrol of Ugandan soldiers that formed part of the African Union Mission to Somalia (AMISOM) were ambushed and attacked in a farmland about 2½ kilometers from Golweyn (some 100 km south of Somalia's capital Mogadishu) by Al-Shabaab Islamic militants while on a routine patrol to secure the main supply route along the Beldamin-Golweyn Forward Operating Base in the Lower Shabelle.

zh.s: 2021年8月10日，非洲联盟驻索马里特派团（AMISOM）的一支乌干达士兵巡逻队在戈尔韦恩附近一处农田遭到索马里青年党武装分子伏击并袭击。该地点距戈尔韦恩约2.5公里，戈尔韦恩位于首都摩加迪沙以南约100公里。巡逻队当时正在贝尔达明—戈尔韦恩前进作战基地沿线执行例行巡逻，负责保护下谢贝利地区的主要补给路线。

en.s: The 2021 Algerian League Cup final was the 5th final of the Algerian League Cup. The final took place on August 10, 2021, at Stade du 5 Juillet in Algiers with kick-off at 19:00 between NC Magra and JS Kabylie. en.s: The 2022 UEFA Super Cup was the 47th edition of the UEFA Super Cup, an annual football match organised by UEFA and contested by the reigning champions of the top two European club competitions, the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. The match featured Spanish club Real Madrid, winners of the 2021–22 UEFA Champions League, and German club Eintracht Frankfurt, winners of the 2021–22 UEFA Europa League. It was played at the Olympic Stadium in Helsinki, Finland on 10 August 2022.

zh.s: 2022年欧洲超级杯是第47届欧洲超级杯。这项由欧足联组织的年度足球赛由欧洲两大俱乐部赛事——欧洲冠军联赛和欧足联欧洲联赛的卫冕冠军参赛。本届由2021—22赛季欧冠冠军西班牙俱乐部皇家马德里对阵同赛季欧联冠军德国俱乐部法兰克福。比赛于2022年8月10日在芬兰赫尔辛基奥林匹克体育场举行。

en.s: The 2022 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the 26th annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, an exhibition soccer match in the United States. The game, featuring all-star teams from Major League Soccer (MLS) and Liga MX, took place on August 10, 2022, at Allianz Field in Saint Paul, Minnesota. It was the second MLS All-Star Game to be played under the inter-league format.

zh.t: 2022年美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛
zh.s: 2022年美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛是第26届年度全明星赛，也是一场在美国举行的表演赛。比赛由美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）和墨西哥足球联赛（Liga MX）的全明星队参加，于2022年8月10日在明尼苏达州圣保罗的安联球场举行。这是该赛事第二次采用联赛间对抗形式。

en.t: Football at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's tournament final
en.s: The 2024 Summer Olympic women's football gold medal match was a football match to determine the winners of the women's football tournament at the 2024 Summer Olympics. The match was the eighth final of the women's football tournament at the Olympics, a quadrennial tournament contested by the women's national teams of the member associations of FIFA to decide the Olympic champions. The match took place at Parc des Princes in Paris, France, on 10 August 2024.

en.s: On 10 August 2024, Israel struck the Al-Tabaeen school located in eastern Gaza City, which was hosting displaced Palestinians seeking shelter there during the Gaza war. According to Palestinian health authorities, at least 80 Palestinians were killed and 47 others were injured, with several victims being trapped in the school as the fire spread. The IDF said that these numbers were inflated.

en.s: The 2025 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship final, the 94th event of its kind and the culmination of the 2025 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, was played at Croke Park on 10 August 2025.
